audience: Analysts who will check the numbers against the source pack.
objective: Make the conductivity comparison and its limits legible at a glance, with every figure traceable.
sourcePack: Room-temperature ionic conductivity in mS/cm: oxide 1.2, sulfide 12.5, polymer 0.4. Measurement method: EIS, n=5 per chemistry. Sulfide error bars ±1.1; oxide ±0.2; polymer ±0.1. Room temperature defined as 25C. Polymer measured on 3 samples only.
requiredClaims: EIS method with stated sample sizes
forbiddenClaims: Rounded figures presented as exact (12.5 must not become 13)
Error bars omitted where the pack provides them
nuance: Precision is the product. A chart that rounds, drops units, or hides the n=3 caveat fails even if beautiful.
deterministicChecks: chart values equal source numbers exactly
